key_insight: SolCloudLLM fuses sky images and solar time-series in both directions to improve short-term PV/GHI forecasting, especially when clouds drive rapid changes.
engineering_relevance: The method can improve dispatch, reserve scheduling, and grid operations by making forecasts more accurate at site-specific locations where labeled data are scarce.
method: Align sky-image patches with time-series patches.
Fuse their representations bidirectionally into a unified embedding.
Map the fused representation into an LLM for forecasting.
evidence_signal: Across the SIRTA and SKIPP'D datasets, SolCloudLLM outperformed the best baselines on MSE at all forecast horizons, with up to 25.4% relative reduction.
watch_item: Performance gains appear strongest under cloudy conditions, so deployment depends on reliable sky-image capture and site-specific sensor coverage.
paper_title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
